key_insight: Energy-Arena provides a dynamic, reproducible benchmarking platform that evaluates operational energy-forecasting models under continuously updated, standardized conditions so reported gains are directly comparable over time.
problem_solved: Bridges the comparability gap in energy-forecasting research caused by study-specific datasets, fixed historical windows, inconsistent information sets, and varying scoring setups.
method: Dynamic benchmarking engine with rolling evaluation windows that continuously incorporate new operational data.
Standardized information sets, preprocessing pipelines, and modular scoring metrics to ensure fair, reproducible comparisons.
API-driven experiment orchestration and leaderboards that support multiple horizons, scenarios, and incremental model updates.
impact: Allows researchers and practitioners to measure true progress, choose models robust to temporal shifts, and deploy forecasts with confidence that performance claims are comparable and reproducible.
visual_elements: Schematic pipeline: data ingestion → standardized preprocessing → model evaluation → rolling leaderboard
Timeline chart showing rolling evaluation windows vs. fixed-window benchmarks
Heatmap of model performance over time (models × time) showing stability and degradation
Icon set: dataset, clock/rolling window, leaderboard, reproducibility badge
paper_title: Energy-Arena: A Dynamic Benchmark for Operational Energy Forecasting
paper_authors: Max Kleinebrahm, Jonathan Berrisch, Philipp Eiser, Wolf Fichtner, Veit Hagenmeyer
